entries.task: Units are the non-empty lines of the text. The reduced series is the number of words on each line read so far (split on whitespace).

outcome.lesson: a guide needing string escapes was JSON-mangled (raw newline in a JS literal); the model could not repair even with a typed hint — prefer tasks expressible with regex literals, or grammar-constrain hole content to exclude quotes

entries.task: Units are the words of the text, split on whitespace (use a regex literal, not a string). The reduced series is the character length of each word read so far.

fillings.reduce_body: readTo = max(2, floor((readTo * fraction))); units = units.slice(0, readTo); return units.map(unit => unit.length);

outcome.lesson: assigned to an undeclared variable instead of returning — mined into the return-scan (statements holes must return), which now refuses this class before assembly
